title: 第11章 金澜城来的大人物第12章 抵达形守村
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
暗森林。
数名年轻人行走至此。
两女两男，穿着一身玄蓝衣袍，光看料子就知道价格不菲。
“这形守村未免也太偏僻了吧？连条像样的官道都没有，还需要我们徒步越过这暗森林才可以找到。”
一个青年不满的抱怨道。
“对啊！真是搞不懂，为什么我们院长每年还要拨款到这个破地方，帮助这里的村民们修炼！”
又一个青年说道，
“给这些废物修炼，倒不如好好改善一下外院那些师弟师妹们的伙食。”
“在这片天地中，人族应当团结一致。”
走在队伍最前面的女子回头看了一眼方才说话的两位青年，淡淡开口道。
女子看起来双十年华，相貌极美，身材出众，亦是此次太玄剑院派来的代表之一。
“宋师姐，他们两个开玩笑的呢，你可别当真。”
在女子身旁的一个少女嘻嘻笑道。
“方才的语气听起来倒不像是开玩笑。”
宋师姐说道。
她可不是金澜城中人，而是从附近村庄选出来的天才。
如今两个青年说村庄中人的坏话，她怎么可能无视？
这时，一侧的树林中，冲出一个男子的身影。
当男子看到宋师姐几人的时候，脸色一变，慌张的喊道：
“你们几个快点逃走！后面有一头六阶奴仆魔兽！”

男子一身衣物已经满是污渍和血迹，看起来十分的骇人。
“吼！”
男子话音刚落，一头巨大的黑豹就从树林中跳了出来，朝着众人扑咬而去。
“完了！”
王路此时心中暗道一声。
眼前的几个年轻人，怎么会来这暗森林啊？
难道他们不知道这里的凶险吗？
现在以他的速度，根本无法阻止黑豹的攻击。
只能眼睁睁的看着这几人被黑豹攻击。
“孽畜尔敢！”
宋师姐柳眉一皱，正欲出手。
呛！
宋师姐话音刚落，在她身后一道剑光掠过。
直直的斩在了黑豹身上。
呲——
黑豹的身躯笔直的被分成两半，轰然落地。
咔。
content_en:
Dark forest.
Several young people walked here.
Two women and two men were wearing dark blue robes. Just looking at the material, you could tell they were expensive.
"This Xingshou Village is too remote, isn't it? There isn't even a decent official road, and we need to hike through this dark forest to find it."
A young man complained dissatisfiedly.
"That's right! I really don't understand why our dean allocates money to this shabby place every year to help the villagers here practice!"
Another young man said,
"For these losers to train, it is better to improve the food for the junior brothers and sisters in the outer courtyard."
"In this world, the human race should be united."
The woman walking at the front of the team looked back at the two young men who had just spoken, and said calmly.
The woman looks to be twenty years old, with extremely beautiful appearance and outstanding figure. She is also one of the representatives sent by Taixuan Sword Academy this time.
"Senior Sister Song, they are joking, don't take it seriously."
A girl next to the woman giggled.
"The tone just now didn't sound like a joke."
Senior Sister Song said.
She is not from Jinlan City, but a genius selected from a nearby village.
Now two young men were saying bad things about people in the village, how could she ignore them?
At this time, a man's figure rushed out from the woods on one side.
When the man saw Senior Sister Song and the others, his expression changed and he shouted in a panic:
"You guys run away quickly! There is a sixth-level slave beast behind you!"
The man's clothes were covered with stains and blood, and he looked very horrifying.
"Roar!"
As soon as the man finished speaking, a huge black panther jumped out of the woods and attacked everyone.
"It's over!"
Wang Lu thought to himself at this time.
Why did the young people in front of me come to this dark forest?
Don't they know how dangerous this place is?
Now with his speed, there is no way to stop the Black Panther's attack.
I could only watch these people being attacked by the black panther.
"How dare you, you evil beast!"
Senior Sister Song frowned and was about to take action.
choke!
As soon as Senior Sister Song finished speaking, a sword light passed behind her.
It struck straight at the Black Panther.
呲——
The Black Panther's body was split straight into two halves and landed with a crash.
Click.
